Third-party frontend assets
===========================

These files are vendored from the exact package versions used by Butterfly 5.5.3.
They are served locally to keep the rendered site usable when a public CDN is unavailable.

- @fortawesome/fontawesome-free 7.1.0
  Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/v/7.1.0
  License: CC-BY-4.0 AND OFL-1.1 AND MIT (see fontawesome/LICENSE.txt)
- node-snackbar 0.1.16
  Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/node-snackbar/v/0.1.16
  License: MIT (see snackbar/LICENSE)
- @egjs/infinitegrid 4.12.0
  Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@egjs/infinitegrid/v/4.12.0
  License: MIT (see infinitegrid/LICENSE)
- butterfly-extsrc 1.1.6 (Share.js files only)
  Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/butterfly-extsrc/v/1.1.6
  License: Apache-2.0 (see sharejs/LICENSE)
